description: Install dependencies and verify baseline project builds and tests pass. Install new packages needed for the chat feature: react-markdown (markdown rendering), remark-gfm (GitHub flavored markdown support).
steps: Run 'npm install' to install existing dependencies
Run 'npx tsc -b' to verify TypeScript compilation passes
Run 'npx vitest run' to verify existing tests pass
Install new dependencies: 'npm install react-markdown remark-gfm'
Install type definitions if needed (react-markdown ships its own types)
Run 'npx tsc -b && npx vitest run' again to confirm nothing is broken after adding new deps
acceptance_criteria: react-markdown and remark-gfm are in package.json dependencies
Build still passes after adding new dependencies
verification: Run 'npx tsc -b' and confirm exit code 0
Run 'npx vitest run' and confirm all tests pass
Run 'npx vite build' and confirm it succeeds
